extracted.intended_audience: researchers, policymakers, students, and the general public seeking country-by-country environmental profiles and treaty participation
extracted.subtask_description: A global country-by-country listing of environmental problems and the international environmental agreements each country is party to or has signed. Useful as a reference taxonomy of environmental issues and treaty participation status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deforestation
rubrics_metrics.description: deforestation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Causes and contexts given in examples: slash-and-burn agriculture; use of wood for fuel; clearing land for agriculture and settlement; logging. Repeated across many country entries as a primary environmental concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Water pollution
rubrics_metrics.description: water pollution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sources and examples provided: runoff of pesticides and fertilizers; agricultural chemicals; industrial wastes; raw sewage; sewage pollution of specific lakes. Often linked to impacts on potable water supplies and fishing industries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Air pollution
rubrics_metrics.description: air pollution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Noted particularly in urban areas and in regions causing transboundary effects (e.g., acid rain). Examples include emissions leading to acid rain and large CO2 emissions from fossil fuel burning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited natural fresh water / potable water resources
rubrics_metrics.description: limited natural fresh water resources; inadequate supplies of potable water; adequacy of fresh water supply
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many small island states and arid countries rely on catchment, cisterns, or desalination; shortages are linked to emigration or appeals for evacuation in extreme sea-level rise scenarios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Desertification
rubrics_metrics.description: desertification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a recurring problem often in combination with overgrazing, deforestation, and soil erosion; referenced both as a local issue and a broader global concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Soil erosion
rubrics_metrics.description: soil erosion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Associated with deforestation, overgrazing, and poor land management; examples include mountainous islands prone to erosion after clearing forests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overgrazing
rubrics_metrics.description: overgrazing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cited as contributing to soil erosion and desertification in several country entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overhunting / Poaching
rubrics_metrics.description: poaching/overhunting threatens wildlife populations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: widespread poaching threatening rhinoceros, elephants, antelope, and large cats; reduction of black rhinoceros herds attributed to poaching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coral reef damage
rubrics_metrics.description: damage to coral reefs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Causes include starfish outbreaks (Crown of Thorns), indiscriminate coral and shell collectors, and general coastal degradation; impacts on marine biodiversity noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beach erosion and sand removal for building
rubrics_metrics.description: beachhead erosion because of the use of sand for building materials; beach erosion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Noted for small islands where sand removal and rising sea levels threaten coastlines and underground water tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overfishing
rubrics_metrics.description: overfishing threatens marine life populations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a pressure on marine populations alongside water pollution and habitat degradation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Groundwater contamination / contamination of groundwater and soil
rubrics_metrics.description: groundwater contamination limits potable water supply; contamination of soil and groundwater with agricultural chemicals, pesticides
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Causes include industrial wastes, heavy use of fertilizers/pesticides, and buried toxic wastes; leads to human health disorders and loss of potable water.

rubrics_metrics.name: Toxic and hazardous waste disposal ineffective
rubrics_metrics.description: toxic and hazardous waste disposal is ineffective and poses health risks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls out inadequate disposal systems leading to health hazards; sometimes linked to insufficient regulatory or treatment capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sewage pollution / raw sewage
rubrics_metrics.description: water pollution from raw sewage; sewage pollution of lakes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impacts human health and local industries (e.g., fishing); repeated as a municipal/municipal-industrial issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil pollution / oil spills
rubrics_metrics.description: oil pollution of beaches; concern for oil spills from increasing ship traffic; beach pollution from oil spills
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Associated with coastal states, shipping lanes (e.g., Bosporus), and petroleum industry activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Salination / soil salination / water-logging from poor irrigation
rubrics_metrics.description: salination, water-logging of soil due to poor irrigation methods; increasing soil salination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include irrigation practices that degrade soil and reduce agricultural productivity; linked to poor water management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aral Sea shrinkage and exposed lakebed contamination
rubrics_metrics.description: shrinkage of the Aral Sea resulting in growing concentrations of chemical pesticides and natural salts that are then blown from the increasingly exposed lake bed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes a cascade: water diversion → sea shrinkage → exposed salts/pesticides → windblown contamination → desertification and health impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acid rain / transboundary air pollution effects
rubrics_metrics.description: air pollution resulting in acid rain in both the US and Canada; transboundary air pollution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes cross-border environmental impacts; acid rain cited as consequence of industrial emissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial and urban pollution / industrialization impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: industrial and urban pollution, especially along coasts and in large cities; growing urban industrialization rapidly degrading environment in major cities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes industrial discharges, urban runoff, and air pollution from urban centers (e.g., Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City).

rubrics_metrics.name: Loss of wildlife / threat to ecosystems from mining and irresponsible practices
rubrics_metrics.description: loss of wildlife; threat to rainforest ecosystem from irresponsible mining operations; loss of vegetation (overgrazing, deforestation, desertification)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links extractive practices and poor resource management to biodiversity and ecosystem loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited natural resources and overcrowding leading to emigration
rubrics_metrics.description: very limited natural resources and overcrowding are contributing to emigration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes socio-environmental consequence: environmental scarcity combined with demographic pressure drives migration/emigration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invasive / outbreak species (Crown of Thorns starfish)
rubrics_metrics.description: damage to coral reefs from the spread of the Crown of Thorns starfish
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example of species outbreaks causing habitat loss; could represent invasive or outbreak dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inadequate solid/hazardous waste disposal
rubrics_metrics.description: inadequate solid/hazardous waste disposal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls out municipal and industrial waste management shortfalls that create environmental and health risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Soil contamination from buried nuclear processing and agricultural chemicals (including DDT)
rubrics_metrics.description: soil contamination from buried nuclear processing and agricultural chemicals, including DDT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights legacy contamination from past industrial/nuclear/agricultural activities with long-term health and ecological effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lack of adequate water treatment
rubrics_metrics.description: lack of adequate water treatment presents human health risks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes treatment infrastructure gaps that convert pollution into health hazards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited or no permanent settlements due to lack of fresh water
rubrics_metrics.description: there are no permanent settlements on [islands] because of the lack of natural fresh water resources
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes extreme cases where freshwater scarcity prevents permanent habitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beach/Coastal pollution and habitat impacts from tourism/industry
rubrics_metrics.description: beach pollution and coastal degradation from oil and urban pollution, collectors, and development
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show cumulative coastal pressures from tourism, industry, shipping, and local collectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global-scale pressures: overpopulation, industrial disasters, toxic substances, loss of vegetation
rubrics_metrics.description: large areas subject to overpopulation, industrial disasters, pollution (air, water, acid rain, toxic substances), loss of vegetation (overgrazing, deforestation, desertification), loss of wildlife, soil degradation, soil depletion, erosion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes world-level environmental stressors as a compendium of issues many countries face.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greenhouse gas emissions / climate change concerns
rubrics_metrics.description: continues to reduce greenhouse gas emissions; has met Kyoto Protocol target; concerned about global increases in greenhouse gas emissions and their effect on rising sea levels
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References national commitments and concerns over greenhouse gas emissions and sea-level rise; ties policy targets (Kyoto Protocol) to domestic goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of catchment/desalination/rainwater cisterns as water solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: most water needs must be met by catchment systems with storage facilities; desalination plants built; private cisterns collect rainwater
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of adaptation/mitigation measures for scarce water resources; demonstrates infrastructural responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil and mineral extraction region pollution
rubrics_metrics.description: air pollution and resulting acid rain in the mineral extraction and refining region; chemical runoff into watersheds; poor mining practices have led to toxic waste and heavy metal pollution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links extractive industries to localized pollution (air, water, soil) and ecosystem/human health impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: International agreements: party to list
rubrics_metrics.description: party to: [list of agreements such as Biodiversity, Climate Change, Desertification, Endangered Species, Hazardous Wastes, Law of the Sea, Ozone Layer Protection, Wetlands, etc.]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each country, the page enumerates which international environmental agreements it is a party to. This functions as a categorical classification of treaty engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: International agreements: signed but not ratified
rubrics_metrics.description: signed, but not ratified: [specific agreements per country]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For some countries, the page separately indicates agreements that are signed but not ratified (e.g., Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol for certain states). This denotes partial commitment status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Biodiversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Biodiversity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed repeatedly under 'party to' for many countries as a core environmental treaty category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Climate Change / Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Climate Change; Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to denote participation in global climate governance frameworks; some countries are party to Climate Change instruments and separately noted for Kyoto Protocol status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Desertification
rubrics_metrics.description: Desertification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convention obligations related to preventing and combating desertification are tracked per country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Endangered Species
rubrics_metrics.description: Endangered Species
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation indicates commitments on species protection and related trade/regulation measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Hazardous Wastes
rubrics_metrics.description: Hazardous Wastes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convention/agreements on control and disposal of hazardous wastes; presence indicates legal commitments on waste management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Law of the Sea
rubrics_metrics.description: Law of the Sea
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation signals engagement with maritime governance, shipping, and marine resource rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Marine Dumping / Marine Life Conservation / Marine-related treaties
rubrics_metrics.description: Marine Dumping; Marine Life Conservation; Antarctic-Marine Living Resources; Antarctic-Environmental Protocol
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers multiple marine and polar governance instruments; countries may be party to several overlapping marine treaties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Ozone Layer Protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Ozone Layer Protection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convention participation on protecting stratospheric ozone (e.g., Montreal Protocol family).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Ship Pollution / Ship Pollution categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Ship Pollution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denotes participation in international rules controlling pollution from ships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Air Pollution categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Air Pollution; Air Pollution-Nitrogen Oxides; Air Pollution-Sulfur 85; Air Pollution-Sulphur 94; Air Pollution-Volatile Organic Compounds; Air Pollution-Persistent Organic Pollutants; Transboundary Air Pollution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The dataset records participation in multiple specific air pollution agreements or protocols, indicating a fine-grained treaty taxonomy for air quality governance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Tropical Timber (83 / 94)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tropical Timber 83; Tropical Timber 94
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treaty frameworks concerning management and trade of tropical timber; listed separately where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Wetlands
rubrics_metrics.description: Wetlands
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convention on Wetlands (Ramsar) participation noted where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Whaling / Antarctic Seals / Antarctic Treaty family
rubrics_metrics.description: Whaling; Antarctic Seals; Antarctic Treaty; Antarctic-Environmental Protocol
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers polar-region and species-specific conservation commitments; listed where countries engage with Antarctic governance or whaling issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Environmental Modification
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental Modification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refers to agreements addressing environmental modification techniques and impacts; recorded as a treaty category for certain states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement: Marine Life Conservation
rubrics_metrics.description: Marine Life Conservation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate listing for conservation measures aimed specifically at marine biological resources.
